Originally meaning “a chance event” (compare casual, as in “casual encounter”), it developed a negative meaning as “an unfortunate event”, especially the loss of a person.

senses.d: Something that happens by chance, especially an unfortunate event; an accident, a disaster.

Specifically, a person who has been killed (not only injured) due to an accident or through an act of violence; a fatality.
A person in military service who becomes unavailable for duty, for any reason (notably death, injury, illness, capture, or desertion).
An incidental charge or payment.
Someone or something adversely affected by a decision, event or situation.
Chance nature; randomness.
ex: The non-necessary [causes] follow; of which, saith Fuchsius, no art can be made, by reason of their uncertainty, casualty, and multitude […]
